page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs, which map to 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports instruction sets such as AVX, AVX-512, AES, and FMA. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance contrast between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is a notable bottleneck, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% categories respectively. Single-threaded tasks such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also rank in the bottom 10%. However, when utilizing all 16 vCPUs, multi-core performance scales to average levels. Multi-threaded benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, consistently place in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks remains average, as do Passmark database operations and Redis SET operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge offers a balanced resource density for workloads that can parallelize tasks to overcome the weak single-core performance. It is suitable for multi-threaded workloads such as static web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations. It can also handle basic machine learning tasks, as demonstrated by average prompt processing and text generation speeds on small 135M parameter models, though performance drops to weak levels for larger 7B models. It is not recommended for single-threaded processing or applications requiring high-speed local storage.
